idioms.errors: A result type from a library such as neverthrow (ok/err values, andThen/map chains) instead of throw; wrap third-party code that throws at the edge.
idioms.immutability: const bindings, object spread and array spread; never assign to a parameter member or call push/sort/splice on an input.
idioms.routing: A pattern-matching library such as ts-pattern (match(...).with(...).exhaustive()) or a lookup object instead of if/else chains.
idioms.purity: Pure functions in domain code; pass I/O in as arguments; await, chain or return every promise.

regex_rules.message: throw outside an edge file; return a result value
try block outside an edge file; convert the failure at the edge
empty catch handler drops the failure
orphaned async result: await, chain or return it
